job.Job_Description:
This is a remote position.

Mortgage Advisor - Fully Remote

Anywhere in the UK (Fully Remote)

£55,000 - £65,000 OTE (Competitive Base + Commission + Performance Bonus)



Join a Rapidly Growing Financial Services Disruptor

We're partnering with a household name in UK financial services that has tripled in size over the last four years. As a market-leading platform transforming how people access mortgage advice, they're not just keeping pace with change—they're driving it.

With a team of 180+ mortgage professionals across the UK and consistent month-on-month growth, this isn't just another job.
It's your opportunity to be part of a success story that's redefining the mortgage industry through innovation, technology, and exceptional client service.



Why This Role Stands Out

No Cold Calling. Ever.

Imagine starting your day with a pipeline of pre-qualified, warm leads already waiting for you. Our client's proprietary digital platform—developed by industry experts and mortgage advisors - generates a constant stream of genuine applicants who are ready to find their perfect mortgage solution.
You focus on what you do best: providing expert advice and building lasting client relationships.


Technology That Actually Works!

Built by advisors, for advisors. Immagine have everything that you need on a single user friendly screen?

The platform is designed to handle high volumes efficiently, so you can manage 15+ applications per month without the administrative burden. It integrates seamlessly with your workflow, giving you more time for what matters—your clients.
Our client has a experienced team of customer focussed Case Managers / Processors whom will manage all of your cases through to completion.


True Work-Life Balance

Fully remote working with genuine flexibility - 5 days working week



What You'll Be Doing

As a Mortgage Advisor, you'll guide clients through their entire mortgage journey from initial inquiry to submission.

Your responsibilities include:
  • Consulting with pre-qualified leads generated through the company's cutting-edge digital platform
  • Providing whole-of-market mortgage advice tailored to each client's unique circumstances
  • Managing a high-volume pipeline of 15+ applications per month using intuitive, advisor-designed software
  • Building genuine relationships with clients, keeping them informed and confident throughout the process
  • Collaborating with case managers and administrators to ensure seamless application processing
  • Staying current with mortgage products, lender criteria, and regulatory requirements
  • Delivering exceptional outcomes while meeting performance targets and maintaining compliance



About Our Client

Our client is a rapidly expanding disruptor in the UK financial services sector, recognised as a household name by millions of customers.
Over the past four years, they've tripled in size while maintaining their commitment to innovation and client-focused solutions.

Key Facts:
  • 180+ mortgage professionals across the UK
  • Consistent month-on-month growth in both team size and client base
  • Proprietary technology platform developed in-house by industry experts
  • Whole-of-market access to ensure best outcomes for clients
  • Strong lender relationships enabling competitive rates and smooth processing

Our clients mission is simple: make mortgages easier, faster, and more accessible through the perfect blend of technology and human expertise.
They're looking for ambitious Mortgage Advisors who want to be part of this growth story.



Requirements



Essential Requirements:
  • CeMAP Certification (or equivalent qualification) - non-negotiable
  • Minimum 18 months+ experience as a Mortgage Advisor in whole-of-market environments
  • Proven track record of successfully managing 15+ mortgage applications per month
  • Strong knowledge of residential mortgage products, including BTL, remortgage, and purchase scenarios
  • Experience with B2C inquiries and navigating multiple lender criteria
  • Exceptional communication skills - you make complex information accessible and build trust quickly


The Ideal Candidate:

You will thrive working within a fast paced, high-volume environments and loves the buzz of closing deals
Performance-driven with a track record of consistently hitting targets
Highly organised - you manage multiple cases simultaneously without missing details
Client First - you go above and beyond to deliver best-in-class service
Adaptable - comfortable with change and continuous improvement
Collaborative - you work well within a team structure while managing your own caseload



Benefits


Competitive Compensation
Base salary plus excellent bonus structure designed to reward high performers
£55,000 - £65,000 OTE with genuine earning potential
Our client will guarantee your current commission for your first 3 months - whilst you build pipeline


True Remote Working
Work from anywhere in the UK - no commute, no office politics
Top-spec laptop / Computer and equipment provided - everything you need to succeed
Flexible working patterns - choose the 5-day schedule that works for your life


Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • BUPA Health Insurance 
  • Paid holiday allowance - time to recharge and enjoy life
  • Pension contributions - investing in your future
  • Flexible benefits portal - customise your benefits to suit your lifestyle
  • Monthly Commission and regular bonus opportunities - your performance directly impacts your earnings

Career Development
  • Ongoing training and development - stay ahead of industry changes
  • Clear progression pathways - grow with a rapidly expanding company
  • Performance transparency - full access to your metrics and KPIs
  • Supportive team culture - learn from 180+ experienced professionals


Additional Perks
  • Work-life balance - flexible schedules that respect your personal time
  • Cutting-edge technology - tools designed to make your job easier, not harder


How to Apply

If you're a high-performing Mortgage Advisor ready to take control of your career, work remotely, and earn what you're worth and more, we want to hear from you.

This opportunity won't be available for long. With consistent growth and a proven track record of success, positions fill quickly.



Ready to make your move?

Apply now or email your CV to careers@mywork.co.uk with the subject line "Mortgage Advisor Application".

Know someone perfect for this role?
Refer them to careers@mywork.co.uk and earn £250 in vouchers when they successfully join the team.




What Happens Next?

Submit your application - we review all CVs within 48 hours

Initial screening call - a brief conversation to discuss your experience and the role

Progress to client interviews - 2 stage process, completed within 5-7 days
